title: Al Madad Abbas Abbas Al Madad
body:
Aseer karke layeen dar ba dar phirate thee
Behan ko har ghadi abbas yaad aate thee
Al madad abbas, abbas al madad
Ya aaqi abbas, faryaad al madad
Saqa e haram, faryaad al madad
1. Saniye hyder, al madad abbas
Meer o ghanzafer, al madad abbas
Ameer e lashkar, al madad abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Syed o salaar, al madad abbas
Yawar o gham khwar, al madad abbas
Meer alamdaar, al madad abbas
